content_note: The key, voicing, loop lengths, bell motif, and layer levels are project-original modern composition. No surviving source authenticates any music for the original Keth Shipyards, and nothing here is presented as recovered or authentic Keth audio.

layers.musical_note: D natural minor drone on D1/D2 with A2 fifth and a faint F3 third
layers.role: sustained root/fifth deck drone; the always-present floor of the bed

layers.musical_note: Dm9 (D3-F3-A3-C4-E4) with five independent slow swells
layers.role: mid-register swell layer; breathing Dm9 colour above the drone

layers.musical_note: descending D4-A3-F3-E4-D3-A2 bell phrase, silent at both loop boundaries
layers.role: sparse bell motif; the only foreground gesture, reserved for the station at rest

mix_contract.runtime_gain_note: assets deliberately retain deep headroom; the runtime bed applies further per-layer trim and the Music bus carries the authored -6 dB mix offset

musical_contract.combined_cycle_note: 16 s, 12 s, and 20 s loops only realign every 240 s, so the exact three-layer combination repeats once every four minutes.
musical_contract.seamlessness: sustaining layers snap every partial and LFO to an integer number of cycles per loop; the motif layer is silent at both boundaries.

runtime_intent: seamless non-positional music/ambient bed for the non-combat station state
